key_insight: Fun-DDPS couples a function-space diffusion prior over geological fields with a differentiable neural-operator surrogate, enabling fast, accurate forward simulations and efficient inverse (posterior) sampling for subsurface flow in CCS from sparse observations.
problem_solved: Addresses ill-posed, computationally expensive inverse problems in Carbon Capture and Storage where sparse observations and complex geological priors make uncertainty-aware subsurface characterization difficult.
method: Learn a function-space (single-channel) diffusion model as a prior over spatial geological parameters (geomodels).
Train a differentiable neural operator surrogate to approximate the physics-based forward map (PDE solver) for fast, gradient-enabled predictions.
Decouple sampling of geomodels from expensive solvers by combining the diffusion prior with the neural operator in a conditional/inference pipeline for forward and inverse modeling.
impact: Enables scalable, differentiable inference and uncertainty quantification for PDE-governed geoscience problems; practitioners can get orders-of-magnitude faster inversion and easy integration of learned priors into downstream decision workflows.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: diffusion prior -> sampled geomodels -> neural-operator forward surrogate -> simulated observations -> inverse sampling loop

paper_title: Function-Space Decoupled Diffusion for Forward and Inverse Modeling in Carbon Capture and Storage
paper_authors: Xin Ju, Jiachen Yao, Anima Anandkumar, Sally M. Benson, Gege Wen
